environment.databaseIsolation: Temporary PostgreSQL cluster bound to 127.0.0.1:55432. Browser/API used cinema_app and cinema_test_final; TC-WORKER-05 used separately migrated cinema_worker_process_test. Docker and existing PostgreSQL service databases were not used.

coverageNotes: TC-WORKER-05 runs two independent Node worker loops at 250ms intervals for 60 seconds against an isolated PostgreSQL database; it inserts one initial and six periodic outbox events and verifies each is processed exactly once with one reconciliation case.
Both soak processes stop gracefully over IPC; after inserting a new pending event, a replacement process starts and catches it up; all three process instances exit with code 0.
This is a local 60-second soak/restart rehearsal, not a prolonged load test, forced-crash recovery test, or production reliability claim.
Playwright reports 32 expected tests, no skipped, unexpected, or flaky tests across Chromium desktop and Pixel 7 mobile.
